summary: ansible-core releases a new major (the Y in X.Y.Z, written as X.Y like 2.16) roughly every six months in May and November, and X.Y.0 releases are not guaranteed to be fully backwards compatible.
questions: How often does ansible-core release a new major version?
Is 2.19 a major or minor ansible-core release?
Is upgrading from 2.18 to 2.19 guaranteed to be backwards compatible?
In which months are new ansible-core versions released?

answer_card.title: Major ansible-core releases (the Y)
answer_card.answer_md:
A new **major** release comes about every 6 months, in **May and November**. It is the `Y` in `X.Y.Z` but referred to as `X.Y` (e.g. 2.16). So 2.9.0, 2.10.0, 2.16.0 and 2.19.0 are all majors.

`X.Y.0` releases carry **no guarantee** of full backwards compatibility. Check the porting guides before upgrading.
